description: 국토교통부_세계공항코드(신규공항포함) [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 데이터 개요 「세계공항코드(신규공항포함)」 데이터는 전 세계 공항의 영문 및 한글 공항명, IATA(3자리) 코드, ICAO(4자리) 코드, 공항운영상태(기존/신규) 정보를 제공하는. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 영문공항명, 한극공항명, IATA공항코드, ICAO공항코드, 공항운영상태. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-02-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
